iterations.summary: Baseline is the only artefact that makes later `promotion` verdicts reviewable. Two things to carry forward: (1) persist the exact workload tuple (conc=64, isl=1024, osl=1024, max_model_len=6144, fp4, tp=1) alongside the throughput number so comparability can be verified rather than asserted; (2) capture an accuracy reference in the same run if the harness allows, otherwise the first `integrate` proposal will have a throughput before/after but no accuracy floor to gate against.

notes: no whole-stack validation was measured, so the ledger has nothing to reconcile against

No vLLM+MI300X gpt-oss-120b reference script in InferenceX; no reported throughput numbers are embedded in the scripts themselves (they emit RESULT_FILENAME at runtime), so no competitor gap number can be derived here.', 'expected_impact': 'none directly; constrains prior quality', 'accuracy_risk': 'none', 'source': '/home/hasith/AMD/Hyperloom/.cache/InferenceX@3d5581562f643f9bdeb8410cd924e2c70906c966/benchmarks/single_node/fixed_seq_len/deprecated/', 'domain_tags': ['reference_script', 'gpt_oss', 'fp4']}

{'what': 'fp8 KV cache is the single flag both reference stacks agree on for gpt-oss fp4, alongside memory fraction 0.85-0.9 and block size 16.', 'expected_impact': 'more KV headroom -> higher sustained batch at conc 64', 'accuracy_risk': 'low-moderate: fp8 KV quantization can shift long-output accuracy; the accuracy gate should be watched on this variant', 'source': 'gptoss_fp4_mi355x_atom.sh + gptoss_fp4_b200_trt.sh', 'domain_tags': ['kv_cache', 'memory']}

{'what': 'TRT-LLM recipe disables KV block reuse (enable_block_reuse: false) for this fixed-seq-len benchmark, implying prefix caching gives no benefit on random-prompt ISL=1024 and may cost lookup overhead.', 'expected_impact': 'small; candidate for --no-enable-prefix-caching if the baseline enables it', 'accuracy_risk': 'none', 'source': 'gptoss_fp4_b200_trt.sh kv_cache_config', 'domain_tags': ['prefix_caching']}

{'what': 'TRT-LLM recipe sets EP only when EP_SIZE>1 and forces TRTLLM_FORCE_ALLTOALL_METHOD=NotEnabled at EP=1; at our TP=1/EP=1 single-GPU config expert parallelism is a no-op, so MoE wins must come from kernel choice (AITER fused MoE) rather than parallel layout.', 'expected_impact': 'directional guidance for the MoE specialist', 'accuracy_risk': 'none', 'source': 'gptoss_fp4_b200_trt.sh / gptoss_fp4_mi355x_atom.sh EP handling', 'domain_tags': ['moe', 'expert_parallel']}

rows.summary: Only two gpt-oss fp4 reference scripts exist in InferenceX (B200/TRT-LLM and MI355X/Atom), both deprecated; no vLLM MI300X reference. Both converge on fp8 KV cache, ~0.85-0.9 memory fraction, block-size 16, and CUDA-graph padding up to max concurrency. Host sandbox blocked reads of site-packages vllm and model config.json, so flag availability is inferred from vLLM 0.27 upstream, not verified locally. 2 proposals, both from reference-script priors.
